asset_types.label: Humanoid Character
asset_types.description: Player, NPC, or humanoid character; humanoid rules apply only when selected.

asset_types.label: Nonhuman Humanoid
asset_types.description: Bipedal or humanoid-proportioned nonhuman character without assuming a human body template.

asset_types.label: Animal or Wildlife
asset_types.description: Quadrupeds, birds, fish, insects, and other animals sharing reusable animal production techniques.

asset_types.label: Monster or Creature
asset_types.description: Fantasy, horror, or invented creatures with asset-specific anatomy and motion.

asset_types.label: Amorphous Creature
asset_types.description: Slimes and other deforming creatures without a fixed limb layout.

asset_types.label: Plant Creature
asset_types.description: Animated plant-like organisms and plant monsters.

asset_types.label: Mechanical Lifeform
asset_types.description: Robots and mechanical characters whose structure may use rigid or deforming parts.

asset_types.label: Animated Object Character
asset_types.description: Moving object-like characters such as mimics, living tools, or animated props.

asset_types.label: Weapon
asset_types.description: Melee or ranged weapon with game-ready silhouette and attachment considerations.

asset_types.label: Shield
asset_types.description: Handheld or placed shield with readable front, rim, and attachment structure.

asset_types.label: Armor or Clothing
asset_types.description: Wearable armor, garments, and costume components requiring fit and deformation policies.

asset_types.label: Hair or Accessory
asset_types.description: Hair, jewelry, and replaceable character accessories.

asset_types.label: Tool
asset_types.description: Handheld or placed tool with functional proportions.

asset_types.label: Furniture
asset_types.description: Furniture and interior props.

asset_types.label: Container or Storage
asset_types.description: Crates, chests, boxes, and storage objects.

asset_types.label: Machine or Device
asset_types.description: Mechanical devices and ordinary game machinery.

asset_types.label: General Game Prop
asset_types.description: Reusable static or moving game object not covered by a narrower type.

asset_types.label: Attachable or Replaceable Part
asset_types.description: A component intended to attach to or replace part of another asset.

asset_types.label: Building or Structure
asset_types.description: Complete building or substantial architectural structure.

asset_types.label: Architectural Module
asset_types.description: Doors, windows, walls, floors, columns, bridges, and stairs used modularly.

asset_types.label: Dungeon Module
asset_types.description: Reusable dungeon assembly element.

asset_types.label: Terrain or Terrain Piece
asset_types.description: Terrain surface or modular terrain section.

asset_types.label: Vegetation
asset_types.description: Trees, grass, and other environmental vegetation.

asset_types.label: Rock, Mineral, or Ice
asset_types.description: Natural hard-surface environment forms.

asset_types.label: Natural Environment Object
asset_types.description: Other natural environment object not covered by vegetation or geology.

asset_types.label: Modular Environment Set
asset_types.description: Coordinated set of interchangeable environment modules.

asset_types.label: Slash or Sword-Wave Mesh
asset_types.description: Mesh shape for slash, sword-wave, or directional attack effects.

asset_types.label: Shockwave Mesh
asset_types.description: Ring, cone, or surface mesh used as a shockwave effect component.

asset_types.label: Magic Circle Mesh
asset_types.description: UV and material-ready mesh for a magic circle effect.

asset_types.label: Energy Ring Mesh
asset_types.description: Mesh component for an energy ring or expanding pulse.

asset_types.label: Explosion Debris Mesh
asset_types.description: Reusable shard or fragment geometry for explosion effects.

asset_types.label: Beam or Energy Mesh
asset_types.description: Beam, ribbon, or other energy-form mesh component.
